source_spans.locator: Institutional abstract: categorization strategies and standard models are evaluated at successive learning stages for smaller less-differentiated and larger more-differentiated category structures.
Institutional abstract: for smaller less-differentiated categories, exemplar-based processing dominates even early in learning.
Institutional abstract: for larger more-differentiated categories, prototype-based processing has a strong early advantage that diminishes slowly.
Institutional abstract: model behavior suggests a psychological transition from prototype-based to exemplar-based processing and different category structures produce different learning trajectories.

provenance.venue: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition
